project.title: Dinoyo Kamera - Integrated Business Information System
project.description: An integrated information system covering Dinoyo Kamera business processes, from inventory to quality control.
project.longDescription: An integrated business information system covering Dinoyo Kamera operations, including inventory, purchasing, sales, quality control, and reporting. The system is designed to improve operational efficiency and business data accuracy.
project.challenge: Inventory, purchasing, sales, and quality control operated separately at Dinoyo Kamera. Disconnected data led to duplicate records and input errors.
project.solution: Built an integrated information system connecting business processes in one platform. Data flows automatically between modules to reduce input errors and improve efficiency.
project.goal: Integrate Dinoyo Kamera business processes to improve efficiency and data accuracy.
project.outcome: More accurate business data, faster processes, and easier decision-making.

project.title: Guess The Song - Music Quiz Game
project.description: Interactive music quiz game where players guess song titles from 7-second audio previews. Built with Next.js and iTunes API.
project.longDescription: Guess The Song is a fun, interactive web game that tests your music knowledge. Players choose their favorite artist, listen to a 7-second audio preview from the middle of a random song, and guess the correct title from three multiple-choice options. The game features a scoring system, progress tracking, and supports 10 rounds per session with stats calculation at the end.
project.challenge: The main challenge was working with the iTunes API which only provides 30-second previews starting from the beginning of songs. The goal was to create a fair 'middle of the song' experience without access to the full track or custom preview points. Additionally, handling HTTP preview URLs on HTTPS websites and ensuring smooth audio playback across different browsers required careful implementation.
project.solution: I implemented a custom audio player with timeline control that attempts to start playback from the 10-second mark. A fallback mechanism automatically plays from the beginning if seeking fails due to CORS restrictions. The iTunes API is proxied through Next.js rewrites to solve HTTPS mixed-content issues. The game also features a debounced search for artists, glassmorphic UI design, and real-time progress tracking to enhance user experience.
project.goal: To build a fun, accessible music quiz game that anyone can play without requiring Spotify or Apple Music subscriptions. The goal was to create an engaging experience that tests music knowledge while maintaining a clean, modern UI.
project.outcome: A fully functional web game that allows users to test their music knowledge across various artists. The game features smooth audio playback, intuitive UI, and comprehensive game statistics. It's deployed and accessible to anyone with an internet connection.

project.title: YBLP Digital Beneficiary & Program Management System
project.description: A centralized digital system for managing foundation beneficiary records and social programs.
project.longDescription: Developed to digitize recordkeeping at Yayasan Bumi Langgat Peduli, this system covers records for orphans and low-income beneficiaries, program sessions for financial assistance, mass circumcision, and home renovation, participant management, summary dashboards, reporting, and data exports. It uses Google Apps Script and Google Sheets with a responsive web administration interface.
project.challenge: Previous recordkeeping was prone to duplicate entries, difficult to monitor across programs, and inefficient for periodic reporting.
project.solution: Built an integrated administration system with session authentication, standardized program data, input validation, duplicate participant prevention, and reporting and export tools for daily foundation operations.
project.goal: Create an organized, efficient foundation recordkeeping system with fewer errors to support social program decisions.
project.outcome: The system helps administrators manage beneficiary and program records more efficiently, reduce duplicates, and prepare operational reports faster.

project.title: Dinoyo Kamera - Catalog & Profile Website
project.description: A camera store catalog and profile website that lets customers browse and search products with real-time availability.
project.longDescription: A catalog website for Dinoyo Kamera, a camera store in Malang. Customers can browse cameras and accessories with real-time availability information. Each product includes a direct link to the store administrator on WhatsApp to arrange a purchase.
project.challenge: Dinoyo Kamera needed a digital product catalog with up-to-date stock information. Frequent customer questions about availability took up administrator time.
project.solution: Built a catalog website with product management and real-time stock updates. Customers can check product availability and contact the administrator through WhatsApp to make a purchase.
project.goal: Digitize the Dinoyo Kamera catalog so customers can easily browse products and check stock in real time.
project.outcome: Customers can check availability without asking an administrator, improving sales efficiency.

project.title: Every Woman's Voice Deserves to Be Heard
project.description: A social campaign website supporting women who have experienced violence and helping their voices be heard.
project.longDescription: A static website created for the Perempuan Inovasi 2025 program by Markoding. It supports women who have experienced violence by providing information and creating a supportive space. Built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
project.challenge: Many women who experience violence lack access to information and support. An informative, supportive platform was needed to raise awareness of this issue.
project.solution: Built an informative, empathetic campaign website with a calming design and information about available support.
project.goal: Support women who have experienced violence and provide information about available assistance.
project.outcome: Raised awareness of violence against women and available support.

project.title: Ar-Rahman Mosque Visitor Management System
project.description: A real-time mosque visitor management system with smart LED board integration for Ar-Rahman Mosque in Kitakyushu, Japan.
project.longDescription: A real-time visitor management system developed for an international community service program at Ar-Rahman Mosque in Kitakyushu, Japan. It combines a web application for visitor registration and administration with an ESP32-based smart LED board displaying real-time information.
project.challenge: Ar-Rahman Mosque needed to monitor visitor numbers in real time and display prayer times and mosque events digitally.
project.solution: Built an integrated system combining a visitor registration web application, an administration dashboard, and an ESP32-powered smart LED board for real-time information.
project.goal: Build a modern visitor management system for Ar-Rahman Mosque in Japan as an international community service project.
project.outcome: The system was implemented to help mosque administrators monitor visitors and provide digital information.

project.title: RSS News Aggregator
project.description: A web news aggregator that collects articles from multiple sources using RSS feeds.
project.longDescription: A web application that collects and displays news from multiple sources using RSS feeds. Readers can access the latest articles from different publishers in one platform.

project.title: School Supervision Assessment Tool
project.description: A Google Apps Script web application that helps school supervisors monitor assessment evidence uploaded by schools under their supervision.
project.longDescription: A Google Apps Script web application that helps school supervisors monitor assessment evidence uploads from schools under their supervision. The initial concept was created using Gemini AI, which I then developed into a working application.
project.challenge: School supervisors struggled to monitor assessment evidence submitted by multiple schools manually through email and chat.
project.solution: Built a Google Apps Script application integrated with Google Sheets, allowing schools to upload evidence and supervisors to monitor progress in real time.
project.goal: Help school supervisors efficiently monitor assessment evidence uploads from schools under their supervision.
project.outcome: School supervisors can monitor assessment evidence upload progress in real time without manual checks.

project.title: PiketAgain! — Classroom Cleaning & Ethics Game
project.description: A classroom-cleaning game that brings ethical choices into everyday school responsibilities, developed by a three-person team for a Game Development course.
project.longDescription: PiketAgain! combines classroom-cleaning activities with an emphasis on ethics and responsibility. Players interact with the classroom environment, complete quests, and follow their cleaning progress while responding to situations involving other characters. As team leader, I developed the original concept, designed the game systems, and contributed to implementation alongside two other developers. The team shared implementation work across the game's systems.
project.challenge: The design challenge was to connect cleaning tasks with ethical situations while keeping objectives and interactions understandable to players.
project.solution: The implementation combines interactable classroom objects, quest and progress tracking, NPC dialogue, a timer, and badge systems to support the cleaning-and-ethics concept.
project.goal: Encourage players to reflect on responsibility and ethical conduct through an interactive classroom-cleaning game.
project.outcome: Developed as a three-person Game Development course project. A public playable build is not linked yet.

project.title: Village Profile Website — KKN Community Project
project.description: A village information website and content-management system developed by a seven-person KKN team to organize village profiles, public information, and local potential.
project.longDescription: Developed as part of a KKN community-service project, this website brings together village identity, organizational information, news, agendas, tourism, micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), public documents, and service information. An administrative interface supports content management. I led the seven-person team and worked as a full stack developer. The project was developed but was not adopted by the village; it is presented here as a development project rather than an operational village service.
project.challenge: The information-design challenge was to organize a broad range of village content while giving administrators a practical way to maintain it.
project.solution: A Laravel application separates public information pages from authenticated administration, with content modules for village information, news, agendas, local potential, documents, and services.
project.goal: Provide a central place for village information and showcase local tourism and small businesses.
project.outcome: Developed during KKN by a seven-person team. The village did not adopt the website; a public demo is available.

project.title: TK ABA 8 Kepanjen — School Profile Website
project.description: A school profile website with an administrative workspace for managing school information, teachers, programs, news, achievements, and registration content.
project.longDescription: A freelance website for TK ABA 8 Kepanjen, developed independently across the full stack. The public website presents school information, programs, teachers, curriculum, news, achievements, and contact details, alongside a registration flow. Administrative pages allow school content to be maintained through a dedicated interface. The application uses Next.js and React, with Prisma and MySQL for structured content management.
project.challenge: The implementation challenge was to present a range of school information clearly while allowing content to be updated through an administrative interface.
project.solution: The application combines public school-information pages with authenticated content-management modules backed by Prisma and MySQL.
project.goal: Help families explore the school and provide a practical way to maintain its website content.
project.outcome: Independently developed the school website and administrative application for TK ABA 8 Kepanjen.

project.title: SIBAS — Waste Bank Management System
project.description: A waste-bank management application covering members, waste deposits, savings, inventory, cooperative purchases, and reporting, with separate member and admin workflows.
project.longDescription: SIBAS is a freelance waste-bank management application that I developed independently. Member-facing pages provide access to deposit history, purchase history, savings, notifications, and reports. Administrative modules handle members, waste categories and deposits, savings, inventory, cooperative sales, and reporting. Laravel powers the application, with PDF and spreadsheet libraries supporting report exports.
project.challenge: The workflow-design challenge was to connect waste deposits, member savings, inventory, and cooperative transactions while keeping member and administrative responsibilities separate.
project.solution: The Laravel application organizes operations into member and admin areas, with dedicated modules for deposits, savings, inventory, checkout, and PDF or spreadsheet report exports.
project.goal: Support organized waste-bank operations and give members access to their transaction and savings information.
project.outcome: Independently developed the waste-bank management application and its member and administrative workflows.

project.title: SiPuKa - Camera Store Information System
project.description: A camera store information system connecting a public catalog with product management, purchasing, sales, and quality control.
project.longDescription: SiPuKa combines the Pusat Kamera public website with store operations management. Visitors can browse the catalog, store information, testimonials, and a page for selling cameras to the store. The administration area supports products and photos, categories, customers, branches, purchasing, sales, quality control, and PDF and Excel report exports.
project.challenge: Connect public product information with camera store purchasing, sales, and quality inspection workflows.
project.solution: A Laravel application with a public catalog, authenticated administration, operational modules, and role-based access control.
project.goal: Centralize the camera catalog, product management, and store transactions.
project.outcome: The Pusat Kamera website is available at pusatkamera.id, with a public catalog and operational administration modules.
